scene_features.literal_anchor: gale-force storm surge smashing into coastal buildings and scattering wreckage across the town
scene_features.selection_logic: The source sentence entails three core narrative beats: the arrival of the ferocious storm at the coast, the violent destructive action ripping into town infrastructure, and the resulting state of widespread havoc throughout the settlement. One panel conflates the onset and the resulting state into a vague image. Two panels omit either the physical mechanism of destruction or the broad scale of town-wide havoc. A fourth panel proposing human emotional reactions lacks textual support. Therefore, a three-shot sequence is chosen. The first panel serves as a wide atmospheric baseline showing the storm's arrival; the second panel provides a tighter, physically heavier action of walls and roofs splintering; and the third panel delivers the dominant payoff of an inundated, debris-choked coastal town, justifying a rising emphasis.
